leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an on-call rotation schedule using a calendar-based configuration
Configure incident severity levels and corresponding response time targets
Implement an incident communication workflow with stakeholder notifications
Apply post-incident review templates to document root cause analysis
Integrate monitoring alerts with on-call escalation policies
Manipulate incident timelines to visualize response and resolution phases
Initialize an incident command structure with defined roles and responsibilities
